picks.title: ATTA warns Chinese tourist arrivals could fall 50% after travel advisory
picks.memo: ATTA warns Chinese arrivals could drop up to 50% after the Chinese ambassador's travel safety advisory; urges Thai government to hold urgent talks with Beijing.

picks.title: สุวรรณภูมิแจงสาเหตุ China Airlines ล้อติดรันเวย์ ฝนตกหนักน้ำสะสมทำพื้นผิวชำรุด
picks.memo: China Airlines CI840 main wheels sank into Suvarnabhumi runway surface after heavy rain/water buildup; all 116 passengers safe, runway repaired and reopened.

picks.title: เปิดโปงขบวนการ "พ่อทิพย์-กุมารจีน" เอาสัญชาติไทย 7 เดือนผ่านไปจับได้กี่คน
picks.memo: Crackdown since early 2026 on registration fraud: over 1,400 Chinese children may have obtained Thai nationality illegally via fake Thai fathers.

picks.title: ตร.ตากจับคนไทยอุ้ม 3 ชาวจีนใส่กุญแจมือ-ปิดตา คาดส่งชายแดน
picks.memo: Tak police arrested a group of Thai men who handcuffed and blindfolded 3 Chinese nationals, suspected of taking them across the border to scam centres in Myanmar.

picks.title: ตัดสิทธิบัตรคนจนจุดโป๊ะ! ตำรวจชุมพรบุกบริษัททุเรียน รวบชาวจีนสงสัยทำธุรกิจนอมินี
picks.memo: Chumphon police raided a durian trading company in Lang Suan after a victim lost state welfare card rights for being listed as a director unknowingly; Chinese national held over suspected nominee business.

picks.title: บิ๊กดีลธุรกิจปิโตรฯ สู้ผู้ผลิตจีน ควบรวม 'GC-SCGC' ยื่น กขค.ครึ่งแรกปี 70
picks.memo: GC (56%) and SCGC (44%) to merge petrochemical businesses (assets 180bn baht) to fight Chinese oversupply; filing to competition commission in H1 2027, close H2 2027.

picks.title: ร้าวหนัก! ปักกิ่ง ฟาดฟิลิปปินส์ ก่ออุปสรรคขวางจีน ร่วมถกรมว.กห.อาเซียน-พลัส ซัดทำลายเอกภาพ
picks.memo: Chinese defence ministry spokesman Zhang Xiaogang accused the Philippines of obstructing China at the ADMM-Plus meeting and damaging ASEAN unity.

picks.title: China enforces waste import ban through customs inspections and fines
picks.memo: China screens cargo and scans containers against illegal waste imports; fines up to 5 million yuan and shipments returned.

picks.title: “สุวรรณภูมิ”สั่งพักงานแล้ว เจ้าหน้าที่จุดตรวจค้น ปมดราม่าขวดน้ำผู้โดยสาร แสดงพฤติกรรมไม่เหมาะสม
picks.memo: Suvarnabhumi suspended a security screening officer pending investigation after improper behaviour toward a passenger over a water bottle.

picks.title: Tourist Police Lead Multi-Agency Sweep of Walking Street Venues in Pattaya, Conduct Random Staff Drug Tests
picks.memo: Tourist police inspected Walking Street venues on 29 Oct evening for drugs and illegal firearms, with random urine tests of staff.

picks.title: ฝนถล่มพัทยา! น้ำท่วมหลายสาย รถเล็กผ่านไม่ได้ ถนนเลียบทางรถไฟอ่วมหนัก
picks.memo: Heavy rain flooded several Pattaya roads on 29 Oct; small cars and motorbikes could not pass some spots, railway-side road worst hit.

picks.title: Thailand weather today, 30 October: heavy rain in 12 provinces, Bangkok showers
picks.memo: TMD forecasts heavy rain in 12 provinces on 30 Oct, worst in the south; scattered thundershowers in Bangkok.

picks.title: ผงะ บุกโรงงานระยอง พบกากอุตสาหกรรมปนแผงวงจร–เศษเปลือกสายไฟกว่า 1,000 ตัน
picks.memo: Pollution task force raided a Rayong factory, found over 1,000 tonnes of industrial waste mixed with circuit boards and wire scraps; PCD filed police complaint.

picks.title: Thailand Customs Blacklists 7 Firms in E-Waste Bribery Probe
picks.memo: Thai Customs blacklisted seven import firms after uncovering a scheme to smuggle hazardous e-waste.

picks.title: กบน.เคาะอัตราเงินกองทุนน้ำมันใหม่ ชดเชยดีเซลลิตรละ 1.79 บาท มีผล 30 ต.ค.นี้
picks.memo: Oil Fund committee set new rates: diesel subsidised 1.79 baht per litre, effective 30 Oct.

picks.title: ศุลกากรแม่สายยึดยาบ้า 2.74 ล้านเม็ด ซุกที่นอน–โซฟา มูลค่า 137 ล้านบาท
picks.memo: Mae Sai customs seized 2.74 million meth pills (~137m baht) and 458 vape pod sets hidden in mattresses and sofas in a Myanmar-registered vehicle from Tachileik; 2 arrested.

picks.title: Mae Sot troops on alert as Myanmar fighting spills over border
picks.memo: Thai troops tightened security in Mae Sot after Myanmar clashes sent stray bullets and fragments into Thai territory; villagers took shelter.

picks.title: Singapore Funds Named in Huge Thai Money Laundering Case
picks.memo: Thai SEC and law enforcement uncovered a large cross-border money laundering scheme involving Singapore-based funds.

picks.title: Thailand Revokes Citizenship of Rabbi Yosef Chaim Kantor
picks.memo: Thailand stripped long-time Jewish community leader Rabbi Yosef Chaim Kantor of citizenship after reported repeated violations.

picks.title: “สกลธี” ยื่น ร่าง พ.ร.บ. ควบคุม “กัญชา” คุมเข้มเน้นทางการแพทย์-เพิ่มโทษหนัก
picks.memo: Sakoltee Phattiyakul submitted a cannabis control bill limiting use to medical purposes with heavier penalties, plus a bill for 6 zone mayor elections in Bangkok.

picks.title: บขส. เพิ่มเที่ยวรถ กรุงเทพฯ-หนองคาย รับมหกรรม 'พืชสวนโลกอุดรธานี 2569'
picks.memo: BKS adds up to 10 Bangkok–Nong Khai bus trips a day for the Udon Thani World Horticultural Expo 2026.

picks.title: Khao San Road Gears Up for Biggest Halloween Night Yet
picks.memo: Khao San Road is preparing a large open-air Halloween costume carnival.

picks.title: Chonburi Coffee on the Beach 2026 Set for Pattaya Beach November 13–15th
picks.memo: Chonburi Coffee on the Beach runs 13–15 Nov 2026 at Central Pattaya Beach with coffee stalls, sunrise runs, sunset cycling and workshops.
